title: Manage Employee Contracts Effortlessly with SpotDraft
markdown:
SpotDraft For HR

# Cut Paperwork, Boost Hiring

Behind every offer letter, promotion, or policy update is a contract. SpotDraft helps HR teams automate contract creation and approvals, so you never delay a hire due to paperwork.

[Request a demo](https://www.spotdraft.com/request-a-demo)

## Why HR Teams Choose SpotDraft

![User interface form titled 'Create Offer' with fields filled for candidate name James Sawyer, email jsawyer@acme.com, location New York, and salary amount USD 120000, and a cursor pointing at the Save button.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/68627fe2b0963beebe7fb1bb_Group%201171275674.avif)

### Faster, Smoother Onboarding

- Auto-generate offer letters and contracts from Greenhouse or your ATS
- Pre-fill fields like name, role, compensation, and start date
- Pre-fill fields Route contracts for internal approvals and eSignature in minutes like name, role, compensation, and start date

### One Source of Truth for All Employee Contracts

- One secure platform to store all employee contracts—offer letters, appraisals, transfers, and more
- Powerful filters and views tailored to contract type, date, or team, so you can retrieve the right contract instantly

![Contract repository interface showing filters 'Employment Agreement' and 'Last 30 Days' with a table listing contracts by Contract ID, Owner with photos, Contract URL, and Creation date.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/6866707dd16d3b6d85f535fa_Frame%202147224437%20(2).avif)

![Summary of approved agreements featuring icons and photos: Concrete slabs added to greenhouse; Finance confirms employment agreement approval; HR informs Finance about approved employment agreement for James Simpson.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/686282445f4d7610080ba312_Frame%202147224451.avif)

### Bring HR, Legal, and Finance Together

- Automatically route contracts to teams, like Legal and Finance, for review and approval, based on  role
- Collaborate directly within SpotDraft—comment and resolve without relying on email or Slack
- Activity logs and reminders ensure nothing slips through the cracks

### Fast, Frictionless Signing, Built In

- Use SpotDraft’s native, legally binding eSignature—no external tools required
- Get contracts signed quickly—without toggling between tools

![Digital employment agreement document with an overlay showing options to draw, type, or upload a signature, and a handwritten signature drawn.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/686282d06c70813f55e6359f_Group%201171275665.avif)

## Integrate SpotDraft where your team works, not around it

### Greenhouse

Speed up offer rollout, eliminate manual errors, and deliver a smooth candidate experience—right from your ATS.
